ValidationRule.description: Check if all franchise fields are null
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISNULL(MTD_Total_Franchise__c), MTD_Total_Franchise__c = 0), OR(ISNULL(YTD_Total_Franchise__c), YTD_Total_Franchise__c = 0), OR(ISNULL(Prior_year_Franchise__c), Prior_year_Franchise__c = 0) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: All franchise fields cannot be null
